title: zigadenus micranthus var. fontanus
intro: Zigadenus micranthus var. fontanus, commonly known as Death Camas, is a plant species belonging to the lily family and is native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve symptoms and promote healing. Bioactive constituents of Death Camas include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although the plant's toxicity and potential risks should be carefully considered when using it as a remedy.
